note: Both sets cover the same core facts: the 2 ton and 2.5 ton HVAC sizes, lighting (0.20 W/sqft), internal equipment (0.36 W/sqft), infiltration (0.06 ACH/hr), and the two peak cooling loads. Each set makes the identical misbinding error of assigning 14,661 Btu/hr to Louisville, KY when the document shows that value for Irvine, CA (Louisville is 15,853 Btu/hr), and each contains one vague duplicate of the 15,853 Btu/hr claim without a location. Both also omit the peak heating loads (19,802 and 10,059 Btu/hr). With one wrong claim apiece and otherwise equivalent coverage, the sets are effectively equal.
